q: How do I reset my password?
answer: On the sign-in page, click "Forgot password". We email a reset link that expires after 30 minutes.

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan costs $4 per month. It includes unlimited notes and support for 3 devices.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: According to our pricing, the Team plan costs $8 per user per month, so for 5 people, that would be $40 per month.

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: You can keep up to 100 notes on the Free plan. After that, you would need to upgrade or delete old notes. Would you like to know about the available subscription plans?

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: Yes, Plus subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. I don't have the specific details of your purchase history, so please email support@example.com with your order number to initiate the refund.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: According to the FAQ, subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase, so you are outside of that window. I do not know of other options available for you at this time. I would be happy to open a ticket for you to ask.

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: There is no Linux desktop app; however, Linux users can use the web app which is supported on any modern browser.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: No, we require Android 12 or later. You can use our web app on older Android versions.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: No, the web app requires an internet connection to function. The desktop and mobile apps allow you to take notes offline. If you need offline access, please use the native apps.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: You can export your notes as Markdown or PDF. Go to Settings > Export to access your options. Exports are emailed to you as a ZIP file.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: You can restore it within the Trash bin as it stays there for 30 days. Open the Trash, select the note, and click "Restore" to get it back.

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: SMS codes are not supported. We only offer authenticator apps for security. You can find instructions in the Settings menu.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: On the Free plan, the maximum file size is 25 MB per file.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: You retain paid features until the end of your current billing period if you cancel today.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: Your notes are stored in AWS data centers located in the United States, and all data is encrypted both at rest and in transit.

q: How long does support take to reply?
answer: We reply to email support@example.com within one business day.

q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
answer: Yes, annual billing saves 20% off the monthly price.

q: How many devices can I use with Plus?
answer: According to the Plus plan details, you can use up to 3 devices.

q: Do you offer a student discount?
answer: I don't have specific information about student discounts in my current resources. I can open a support ticket for you to check.

q: Is Example Notes HIPAA compliant?
answer: I do not have that information in the provided FAQ. I can open a support ticket to investigate this for you, or you can send an email to support@example.com.

q: Can I import my notes from Evernote?
answer: I'm sorry, but that isn't covered in our FAQ. For assistance with that request, I can open a support ticket for you

q: When will the Linux desktop app be released?
answer: I don't have that information in my FAQ. I would be happy to send a message to our support team to check for you. Would you like me to open a support ticket?

answer:
I cannot assist with that. I am designed specifically to support Example Notes and should not write Python scripts.

If you have any questions about your account, subscription, or the app itself, please let me know.

answer: I'm sorry, I don't have access to weather updates in my FAQ.

q: And how do I undo that?
answer: Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days; go to Trash and click "Restore".

q: Which one gives me shared workspaces?
answer: The Team plan ($8 per user per month) includes shared workspaces and admin controls.

q: And on the paid plans?
answer: Pro and Team plans allow for a 250 MB file limit per attachment.

q: I only bought it 5 days ago. Can I get the money back instead?
answer: Yes, Plus subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days. You just need to email support with your order number.

q: パスワードを忘れました。どうすればいいですか？
answer: サインインページで「パスワードをお忘れの方」をクリックし、メールで受け取るリンクを使って再度設定してください。リンクは30分以内に有効期限が切れます。その他ご不明な点があれば、サポートへお問い合わせください。

q: This is the THIRD time your app lost my notes. Your product is garbage. How do I get them back???
answer: I apologize for the frustration. Deleted notes remain in the Trash folder for 30 days, where they can be restored. If that fails, please email support@example.com so a human can assist you.
